name: pr-agent-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for the PR-Agent skills: the maintainer and local-review skills, and the optional review-pair pane.

plugins.name: pr-agent-maintainer
plugins.description: Review, triage and reply to The-PR-Agent/pr-agent's own issues and pull requests: verify by running, draft for the maintainer, post or merge only on their word.

plugins.name: pr-agent-local-review
plugins.description: Run PR-Agent's own /review on a GitHub pull request from a local checkout, with the coding agent answering the prompt.

plugins.name: review-pair
plugins.description: Shows the pull requests or issues under review in a pane beside live GitHub state.
